rows.ja: 電力会社・仮想発電所の提携先

source.label: Sunrun 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For example, we completed the acquisition of Vivint Solar on October 8, 2020.

companies.name: ソーラーエッジ
companies.sub: パワーコンディショナ

relations.text: SolarEdgeが2024年12月、Sunrunとセーフハーバー契約(税額控除向けの機器確保)を結んだ
relations.text_en: SolarEdge signed safe harbor agreements with Sunrun in late December 2024

source.label: SolarEdge の発表(8-K添付)
source.quote: In late December, SolarEdge signed safe harbor agreements with Sunrun, as well as with one of the largest financiers of residential solar installations in the United States.

relations.text: テキサス州で、Tesla ElectricとSunrunの家庭向け電力プランを共同で提供
relations.text_en: Offers the Tesla Electric + Sunrun Flex home energy plan in Texas

source.label: Sunrun 2025年第2四半期決算発表
source.quote: Sunrun and Tesla Electric Partner to Provide Home Energy Plan for Texans: The Tesla Electric + Sunrun Flex plan is exclusively available for Sunrun Flex customers in Texas.

relations.text: Sunrun・Renew Home・Teslaの3社で、16GW超の分散型電力をハイパースケーラーや電力会社に届ける基本合意(拘束力なし)
relations.text_en: Sunrun, Renew Home and Tesla signed a non-binding letter of intent to deliver over 16 GW of distributed capacity to hyperscalers and utilities

source.label: Sunrun 2026年第2四半期決算発表
source.quote: In June 2026, Sunrun, Renew Home, and Tesla announced a non-binding letter of intent to deliver more than 16 gigawatts of fast, flexible energy capacity to hyperscalers and utilities

relations.text: テキサス州で、Tesla Electric・Vistraと2つの仮想発電所を運営
relations.text_en: Partnered with Tesla Electric and Vistra on two virtual power plants in Texas

source.label: Sunrun 2024年第3四半期決算発表
source.quote: In Texas, Sunrun partnered with Tesla Electric and Vistra on two virtual power plants.

companies.name: PG&E
companies.sub: 電力会社(カリフォルニア)

relations.text: 家庭用蓄電池でPG&Eの配電網の負荷を軽くし、設備増強を先送りできるようにする
relations.text_en: Uses home batteries to relieve load on PG&E's grid and help it defer distribution upgrades

source.label: Sunrun 2025年第4四半期決算発表
source.quote: The goal of the precise, location-specific load relief is to help PG&E avoid or defer distribution upgrades while generating net savings for all utility customers.

relations.text: Exelon傘下のBGE(メリーランド州)と組み、EVのFord F-150 Lightningを使う家庭向け仮想発電所を開始
relations.text_en: Partnered with Exelon's BGE in Maryland on a vehicle-to-home virtual power plant using Ford F-150 Lightnings

source.label: Sunrun 2024年第3四半期決算発表
source.quote: In Maryland, Sunrun launched the nation's first vehicle-to-home virtual power plant, partnering with Baltimore Gas and Electric Company (BGE), a subsidiary of Exelon Corporation (Nasdaq: EXC), to utilize a small group of customer-owned Ford F-150 Lightnings.

relations.text: Ford F-150 Lightningの電池から電力網に放電する試験プログラムを運営
relations.text_en: Runs a pilot that dispatches energy from Ford F-150 Lightning trucks to the grid at peak times

source.label: Sunrun 2025年第3四半期決算発表
source.quote: This pilot program is dispatching energy from participating customers' all-electric Ford F-150 Lightning trucks to support the grid during periods of peak demand and demonstrates the critical role batteries can play in powering the nation's grid.

relations.text: プエルトリコで電力不足が見込まれると、Sunrunの家庭用蓄電池が放電して電力網を支える
relations.text_en: When LUMA foresees a supply shortfall in Puerto Rico, Sunrun's home batteries discharge to stabilize the grid

source.label: Sunrun 2024年第1四半期決算発表
source.quote: When Puerto Rico's electric utility provider, LUMA, foresees a power supply shortfall, Sunrun's fleet of batteries dispatches more than 15 megawatt hours of stored energy to stabilize the grid.

relations.text: 2025年12月、分散型エネルギーの資金調達でSunrunと合弁を組み、最大5億ドルを投資
relations.text_en: Formed a joint venture with Sunrun in December 2025 to finance distributed energy, investing up to $500 million

source.label: HASI 8-K(2026年2月)
source.quote: In December 2025, we formed a joint venture with Sunrun Inc. to finance distributed energy assets and agreed to invest up to $500 million into the joint venture.

companies.name: ナショナル・グリッド

relations.text: National Gridが、Sunrunの資金調達会社(Sunrun Neptune 2016)に投資
relations.text_en: National Grid holds an investment in Sunrun Neptune 2016 LLC

source.label: National Grid 20-F(2026年3月期)
source.quote: These comprise our portfolio of investments made by National Grid Partners and our investment in Sunrun Neptune 2016 LLC (both within NGV).
